pageDescription: Verified overtime, attendance, leave and headcount over time — projected from the workforce event stream, never read from the operational tables.

tabDescriptions.overtime: Verified hours, claim counts and hours per active employee.
tabDescriptions.headcount: Active headcount at each bucket end, plus joiners and leavers.

empty.headcount: No headcount in this range — no employee was employed during these buckets.
